DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご自身に起きたことから教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Unahin ang nangyari sa inyo mismo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私と同僚の二人が困っています。同僚の話もまとめて、同じ被害として伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分と同僚の話をまとめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Ako at katrabaho ay parehong nahihirapan. Gusto kong pagsamahin ang kuwento niya at iulat bilang parehong pinsala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing gustong pagsamahin ang sarili at kuwento ng katrabaho. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ日時や場所の出来事でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Parehong oras at lugar ba ang pangyayari?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 違います。私は昨日、同僚は先週だと聞きました。同じ相手かも確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 日時と相手の同一性が未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi. Kahapon sa akin, noong isang linggo raw sa kaniya. Hindi pa rin tiyak kung parehong tao ang sangkot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na di tiyak ang oras at pagkakapareho ng tao. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら、別の話を同じ出来事と決めずに説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kung ganoon, huwag ituring na iisang pangyayari ang magkaibang kuwento.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。先に自分に起きたことを話し、同僚の分は聞いた話と明確にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の出来事と伝聞を区別して話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Uunahin ang nangyari sa akin, at lilinawing narinig lang ang sa katrabaho.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang sariling pangyayari at narinig. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同僚ご本人からの説明が必要になる場合もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Maaaring kailanganin din ang paliwanag mismo ng katrabaho.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同僚には自分で相談する方法を伝えます。私が同僚の気持ちや事実を勝手に決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同僚には本人相談を案内し代わりに断定しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sasabihin ko kung paano siya kumonsulta. Hindi ko basta pagpapasiyahan ang damdamin o katotohanan niya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ituro ang personal na konsultasyon at huwag magpahayag bilang kapalit. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。ご自身の日時や経過を記録してお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo. May dala kayong tala ng sarili ninyong petsa at pangyayari?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモがあります。自分の記録と同僚のメッセージを分けて見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の記録と同僚のメッセージを分けて提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: May tala. Hiwalay kong ipapakita ang sarili kong rekord at mensahe niya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipakita nang hiwalay ang sariling rekord at mensahe ng katrabaho. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人の説明を中心に、担当者が必要な確認を行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Susuriin ng kawani ang kailangan batay pangunahin sa inyong sariling paliwanag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 郵便物についてのご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。さっきこの前のポストへ入れましたが、部屋番号を間違えました。開けて返してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 投函後の宛先誤りと取り戻しを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Inihulog ko kanina sa postbox sa harap pero mali ang room number. Maaari bang buksan at ibalik?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang maling address at pagbawi matapos ihulog. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: すぐにポストからお返しできるとは限りません。差出し状況を担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi laging maibabalik agad mula sa postbox. Titingnan ng kawani ang kalagayan ng pagpapadala.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ窓口の発送前だと思うのとは違うんですね。投函した時刻と封筒の特徴を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 発送前の訂正と違うと理解し投函情報を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Iba pala sa pagwawasto bago ipadala sa counter. Ibibigay ang oras ng paghuhulog at katangian ng sobre.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Unawaing iba sa pagwawasto bago ipadala at ibigay ang posting details. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お願いします。手紙には、ご自身の差出人住所も書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Pakisuyo. Nakasulat din ba ang sarili ninyong sender address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。白い封筒で、右下に私の名前があります。中身は申請書です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 封筒の特徴と差出人表示を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Oo. Puting sobre, pangalan ko sa ibabang kanan. Application form ang laman.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang katangian at sender details. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対応方法や受付条件は担当者が案内します。取り戻せると決まる前に、同じ申請書をまた送りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapaliwanag ng kawani ang paraan at kundisyon. Bago tiyak na mababawi, ipadadala ba muli ang parehong aplikasyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二重提出になるかもしれないので、今は再送しません。先にこの手紙への対応を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二重提出を避け再送を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi muna dahil baka dobleng pagpasa. Titiyakin muna ang gagawin sa liham na ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Iwasang madoble at ipagpaliban ang pagpapadala muli. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。正しい宛先も記録しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Itala rin ang tamang padadalhan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。誤った部屋番号と正しい番号を分けてメモし、担当者へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 誤宛先と正宛先を区別して担当者に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Ihiwalay sa tala ang maling room number at tama, saka kumonsulta.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang maling address at tama at kumonsulta sa kawani. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。投函後の郵便物の相談として担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Oo. Ipapasa bilang konsultasyon sa naihulog nang koreo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込人のお名前はこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tama itong pangalan ng nagpapadala ng transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の支払いなので、私の名前ではなく会社名にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事の支払いで会社名の名義を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Bayad ng kumpanya kaya pangalan ng kumpanya, hindi akin, ang gusto ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Hilingin ang pangalan ng kumpanya sa bayad sa trabaho. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社から、どの名義で払うよう指示されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Anong pangalan ang utos ng kumpanya para sa bayad?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 金額と口座だけです。会社名にすれば、会社の口座から払ったように見えると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名義の指示がなく会社口座になると誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Halaga at account lang. Akala ko kung pangalan ng kumpanya, magmumukhang mula sa company account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na walang utos sa pangalan at maling akalang company account. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示する名義と、実際に支払う口座は別の情報です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Magkaibang impormasyon ang ipinapakitang pangalan at ang aktuwal na paying account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうですね。会社の口座を使うことにはなりません。経理に個人から払ってよいか先に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 表示名義と支払い口座を区別し経理へ確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Tama. Hindi ito paggamit ng company account. Itatanong muna sa accounting kung puwedeng mula sa personal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang display name at paying account at tiyakin sa accounting. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その確認が済むまで、手続きは保留しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ihihinto muna ang proseso hanggang matiyak?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。名義も含めた指示が届いてから決めたいです。今の記入は確定しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社の指示が来るまで手続きを保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Oo. Magpapasiya kapag may utos pati pangalan. Huwag munang gawing pinal ang kasalukuyang entry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipagpaliban hanggang utos ng kumpanya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。会社への確認内容を整理しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Ayusin ang itatanong sa kumpanya.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 金額、振込名義、個人立替の可否を聞きます。返事が来てから必要な手続きを相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金額・名義・立替の可否の確認点を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Halaga, transfer name, at pahintulot sa personal na abono. Pag may sagot, ikokonsulta ang kailangang proseso.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ayusin ang pagtiyak ng halaga, pangalan, at pahintulot sa abono. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。本日は振込を実行せず、確認後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Hindi magsasagawa ng transfer ngayon, gagabayan matapos matiyak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの商品をまとめて会計しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Sabay bang i-checkout ang mga ito?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社用の飲み物と、家族用の食品があります。会社へ出す記録は別にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社用と私用の買い物記録を分けたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: May inumin para sa kumpanya at pagkain ng pamilya. Gusto kong hiwalay ang rekord na ibibigay sa kumpanya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Hilinging ihiwalay ang company at personal na shopping records. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだ会計前なので、商品を分けて確認できます。どれが会社用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Bago bayad pa kaya puwedeng ihiwalay. Alin para sa kumpanya?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この飲み物四本です。残りは私用です。支払いも会社分と私用を別にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社用商品を特定し支払いも分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Itong apat na inumin. Personal ang iba. Hiwalay din sanang bayad ng kumpanya at personal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tukuyin ang company items at sabihin hiwalay din ang bayad. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二回の会計として承ります。会社の記録の形式は指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Dalawang transaksiyon. May itinakdang anyo ng rekord ang kumpanya?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: レシートでよいと聞きました。会社名の領収書が必要とは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社が求める記録形式を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sabi sapat ang till receipt. Wala akong narinig na kailangan ng formal receipt na may pangalan ng kumpanya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang record format na hinihingi ng kumpanya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では飲み物分と食品分のレシートを別にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Hiwalay na till receipts sa inumin at pagkain ang ibibigay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。飲み物を一回、食品を次の一回で、商品が混ざらないか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会計順序と商品区分を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Pakisuyo. Inumin sa una, pagkain sa kasunod; titiyaking hindi halo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang ayos ng bayad at paghahati ng produkto. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。最初に会社用の飲み物だけ会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo. Company drinks lang muna ang una.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。受け取った二枚に自分で区別を付けて、会社には飲み物の分だけ渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二枚を区別して会社分だけ提出すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat. Mamarkahan ko ang dalawang resibo para maiba at inumin lang ang ibibigay sa kumpanya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang dalawang resibo at company part lang ang ipasa. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの会計とレシートを分けて進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Hiwalay ang dalawang bayad at resibo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 放送について何かご質問ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: サイレンが聞こえました。訓練の紙を見たので、何もせず待てばいいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: サイレンを古い掲示から訓練だと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: May siren. Nakakita ako ng drill paper kaya akala ko walang gagawin at maghihintay lang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na inakalang drill ang siren dahil sa lumang paskil. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の案内を聞き取れましたか。以前の紙だけで現在の状況は決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Narinig nang malinaw ang kasalukuyang gabay? Huwag magpasya sa kasalukuyan batay lang sa lumang papel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 内容は聞き取れませんでした。今日の訓練なのか、どこへ動く案内なのか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現在の放送を聞けず内容確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi ko naintindihan. Gusto kong tiyakin kung drill ngayon at saan dapat gumalaw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing di narinig ang kasalukuyang anunsiyo at alamin ang laman. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では、今行っている訓練の集合案内です。担当者が場所を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sa sitwasyong ito, assembly instruction ng drill na kasalukuyang ginagawa. Ipapaliwanag ng kawani ang lugar.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。ただの音だと無視するのでなく、今の指示を確認して参加の扱いを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今の指示を確認し訓練参加の扱いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Hindi babalewalain na tunog lang; titingnan ang kasalukuyang utos at itatanong ang pakikilahok sa drill.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang kasalukuyang utos at itanong ang pakikilahok. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訓練の担当者へご案内します。実際の緊急案内が出た場合は、その案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ituturo sa drill staff. Kung totoong emergency instruction, sundin iyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。次の放送も聞き、分からなければ担当者に聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次の案内も確認し不明時は聞き直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Oo. Pakikinggan din ang susunod at magtatanong muli kung di malinaw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing titingnan ang susunod at uulitin ang tanong kung malabo. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 同行の方にも、今分かった内容を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sabihin din sa kasama ang nalaman ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族には訓練の集合案内と確認できたことを伝え、集合先は担当者の説明で確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認済みの内容だけ家族へ伝え集合先を担当者に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Sasabihin sa pamilya na natiyak na drill assembly; lugar ay titiyakin sa paliwanag ng kawani.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirmed lang ang sabihin sa pamilya at itanong ang assembly point sa kawani. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの担当者から、現在の集合案内を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Tanggapin ang kasalukuyang assembly instructions mula sa kawaning ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の底がぬれているようですが、大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Mukhang basa ang ilalim ng dala, ayos lang?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鉢植えを運んでいます。朝水をやったので、箱から少し漏れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鉢植えと漏水の原因として水やりを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Halamang nakapaso. Diniligan umaga kaya may kaunting tagas sa kahon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang paso at pagdidilig bilang sanhi ng tagas. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 床や他のお客様の物へ漏れる状態では、まず対処が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kung tumatagas sa sahig o gamit ng ibang pasahero, kailangan munang ayusin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: このまま乗らず、水が外へ出ないように包み直したいです。通路をふさがない場所でできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 乗車を待ち安全な場所で包み直したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi muna sasakay nang ganito. Ire-repack para hindi lumabas ang tubig. Maaari sa lugar na di haharang?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipagpaliban ang pagsakay at hilinging balutin muli sa ligtas na lugar. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 係員が場所を確認します。持ち込めるかは大きさや状態も見てご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ng kawani ang lugar. Titingnan din ang laki at kalagayan bago sabihing puwedeng dalhin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。箱はこの大きさです。水だけ止めれば必ず持ち込めるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大きさと状態の確認も必要だと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Ganito kalaki. Hindi ko iisiping tiyak na puwede basta mapigil ang tubig.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Unawaing kailangan ding suriin ang laki at kalagayan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。包み直した後にも状態を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Tingnan din matapos ibalot muli.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 袋を持っているので、鉢と箱を分けて包みます。こぼれた所もスタッフに伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 包み直す方法と既に漏れた場所を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: May supot ako, hiwalay ibabalot ang paso at kahon. Sasabihin din ang natapong lugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Iulat ang paraan ng balot at ang natagasang lugar. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。清掃は係員が対応します。広げず、その場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Salamat. Kawani ang maglilinis. Huwag ikalat, ituro ang lugar.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここです。荷物は案内された場所で包み直し、確認が済んでから乗車を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対処後の確認を受けてから乗車を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Dito. Ire-repack sa itinurong lugar, saka ikokonsulta ang pagsakay matapos matiyak.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang pagsakay matapos ayusin at suriin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず漏れた場所と作業場所を係員へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Ipapasa muna ang tagas at work location sa kawani.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 希望する園は、この順番でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tama ba ang ayos ng pinipiling childcare facilities?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三つ書きましたが、優先順位ではありません。思いついた順に並べました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列挙順は希望順位ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Tatlo ang isinulat pero hindi priyoridad. Ayon lang sa naisip.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hindi preference ranking ang listahan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面の用紙は希望順を確認する欄です。まだ順位が決まっていないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa sitwasyong ito para tiyakin ang pagkakasunod ng gusto ang form. Hindi pa tiyak ang ranking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。私が駅に近い園、妻が家に近い園を希望していて、まだ相談中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族で優先したい条件が違うと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Oo. Gusto ko malapit sa istasyon, asawa ko malapit sa bahay; pinag-uusapan pa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang magkaibang priyoridad ng pamilya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当者が用紙の書き方と、確認できる園の情報をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ipapaliwanag ng kawani ang pagsulat at impormasyong maaaring tiyakin sa mga pasilidad.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。空きがあると聞いた園もありますが、入れると決まったわけではないですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 空き情報と申込み結果の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakisuyo. May narinig na may bakante pero hindi ibig sabihing tanggap na, tama?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang pagkakaiba ng vacancy information at resulta ng aplikasyon. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、空きについての情報と、申込みの結果は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Hiwalay ang impormasyon ng bakante at resulta ng aplikasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。通園の距離だけでなく、送迎する人と時間も家族で考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送迎する人と時間も含めて条件を比較する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Hindi lang distansiya, pati sino ang susundo at oras ang pag-iisipan ng pamilya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihambing ang kondisyon kasama ang susundo at oras. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 順位が決まってから、記入内容を確認して申込みをご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Kapag tiyak ang ranggo, tingnan ang entry at ikonsulta ang aplikasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は下書きとして書き方を聞き、家族で順番を決めるまで正式に出しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族の順位決定までは下書き相談に留める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Oo. Draft lang na pagsulat ang itatanong ngayon; di pormal na ipapasa bago magpasya ang pamilya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Draft consultation lang hanggang pumili ng ranking ang pamilya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。希望順が未確定の記入相談として担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Ipapasa bilang fill-in consultation na hindi pa tiyak ang preference order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お子様もご一緒ですね。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私が診察室にいる間、待合で子どもを見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察中の子どもの預かりを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Habang nasa consultation room ako, may puwedeng tumingin sa bata sa waiting room?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta ang pag-aalaga ng anak habang nagpapatingin. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この場面では、子どもの預かりは行っていません。同行の扱いを担当者へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Sa sitwasyong ito walang childcare. Itatanong sa kawani ang pagsama.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 診察を受けることと、子どもを預けることは別なんですね。一人で待たせない方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受診と預かりを区別し単独待機を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Magkaiba ang magpatingin at magpaiwan ng bata. Gusto kong alamin ang paraang hindi maghihintay mag-isa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang pagpapatingin at childcare at iwasan ang solong paghihintay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お子様の年齢と、ほかの保護者が来られるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sabihin ang edad at kung may ibang guardian na makakarating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四歳です。夫に連絡できますが、すぐ来られるかは聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子どもの年齢と家族の対応が未確認だと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Apat. Makokontak ang asawa pero di pa tinanong kung agad makakapunta.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ibigay ang edad at di pa tiyak na tugon ng pamilya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者へ同行について確認し、ご家族への連絡もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titiyakin ang pagsama sa kawani; kontakin din ang pamilya.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。診察室へ入れると自分で決めず、夫が来る場合の待ち時間も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診察同行や家族到着を担当者と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Oo. Di ko ipapasiyang puwedeng pumasok sa kuwarto, at itatanong ang paghihintay kung darating asawa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ikonsulta sa kawani ang pagsama at pagdating ng pamilya. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。今はお子様と一緒にお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Maghintay munang kasama ang anak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。預かってもらえると思って離れず、担当者と家族の返事を聞いてから動きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 子どもから離れず返答を待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Gagawin ko. Di aalis na akala'y aalagaan nila; kikilos matapos sagot ng kawani at pamilya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Magpasiyang manatili sa anak at maghintay sa sagot. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お子様の同行と待機について担当者へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Ipapasa sa kawani ang pagsama at paghihintay ng anak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの説明のまとめをご確認ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この行は「人が入るのを見た」とありますが、私は見ていません。言葉が伝わっていないようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記録の肯定が自分の否定発言と違うと指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sabi rito 'nakita ang taong pumasok,' pero hindi ko nakita. Mukhang di naintindihan ang sinabi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ituro ang positibong rekord na iba sa negatibong sinabi. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、実際に確認したことをもう一度教えてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 帰宅した時に扉が開いていたことだけです。入った人や開けた時刻は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 確認した扉の状態と未目撃の人・時刻を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Bukas lang ang pinto nang umuwi. Hindi ko nakita ang pumasok o oras ng pagbukas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang nakitang pinto at di nakitang tao at oras. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。否定の部分も含め、内容を確認し直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Titiyakin muli kasama ang mga hindi nakita.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。私の日本語が聞き取りにくければ、短い文に分けて書いて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 短い筆記説明を提案する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakisuyo. Kung mahirap pakinggan ang Japanese ko, isusulat sa maiikling hiwalay na pangungusap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Magmungkahi ng maikling nakasulat na paliwanag. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、書いた説明も確認できます。分からない表現はそのまま尋ねてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo. Puwede ring tingnan ang sulat. Itanong ang di maintindihang ekspresyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 記録に難しい言葉があります。意味が分からないまま、合っていますと返事をしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不明語を理解するまで記録に同意しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: May mahirap na salita. Hindi sasagot na tama nang di alam ang kahulugan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi sasang-ayon sa rekord hanggang maunawaan ang salita. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者が意味を説明し、訂正した内容を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapaliwanag ang kahulugan at titiyakin ang inayos na laman.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。扉が開いていたことと、人は見ていないことの両方が記録されているか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 事実と否定の両方が反映されたか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Titiyakin parehong bukas ang pinto at wala akong nakitang tao ang nasa tala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyaking parehong katotohanan at negatibo ang nakasulat. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。否定を含む内容を訂正し、ご本人の説明として再確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Itatama kasama ang negatibo at titiyakin bilang inyong sariling paliwanag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 再配達のご希望ですね。通知を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Gusto ng redelivery, titingnan ang notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。明日の昼に職場へ持ってきてほしいです。時間を選べば住所も変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 再配達の時間選択で住所も変わるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo. Bukas tanghali sa trabaho sana. Kung pipili ng oras, magbabago rin ang address?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung pagpili ng oras ay nagpapalit din ng address. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 時刻の希望と、配達先の変更は別の確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kailangang hiwalay na tiyakin ang oras at pagpapalit ng lugar.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 勤務先の住所をここに書けば済むと思いました。住所変更ができるか先に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛先変更の可否を先に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Akala ko isusulat lang ang work address dito. Sabihin muna kung puwedeng magbago ng address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tiyakin muna kung maaaring palitan ang padadalhan. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 郵便物の種類と通知番号を担当者が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ng kawani ang uri ng koreo at notice number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この通知です。勤務先で個人の荷物を受け取ってよいかも、会社へまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知を示し勤務先での受け取り許可も未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ito. Hindi ko pa rin tinanong kung puwedeng personal na parcel sa kumpanya.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang notice at sabihing di tiyak ang pahintulot sa trabaho. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点も先に確認してください。変更先だけでなく、受け取りが可能な方法を考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tiyakin din iyon muna. Hindi lang bagong lugar, pag-isipan ang magagawang pagtanggap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。会社の確認が取れなければ、自宅で受け取れる別の日時を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 勤務先不可なら自宅の別日時を検討する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naiintindihan ko. Kung walang pahintulot, ikokonsulta ang ibang oras na makakatanggap sa bahay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Kung bawal sa trabaho, mag-isip ng ibang oras sa bahay. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今は時刻も住所も確定せず、条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo. Hindi muna pinal ang oras o address, titiyakin ang kundisyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。再配達の日時と場所を分けて確認し、受け取れる方法が決まってから依頼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 日時と場所の条件を確認後に依頼を確定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakisuyo. Hiwalay kong titiyakin ang oras at lugar, saka hihiling kapag tiyak ang paraan ng pagtanggap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Gawing pinal matapos tiyakin ang kondisyon ng oras at lugar. Sabihin ito sa Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通知の種類と配達先変更の条件を担当者へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-12215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Nauunawaan ko. Itatanong sa kawani ang uri ng notice at kundisyon ng pagbabago ng lugar.
